Check (1) the move is COMPLETE and nothing is left behind or duplicated: no charge_gaps query, migration, Go symbol or doc claim still says telemetry owns it; (2) the move is FAITHFUL - GapWriter's ReconcileWindow logic, error wording, validate-before-transaction order and all-or-nothing commit are unchanged (design.md D2 forbids collapsing it into Recalculate), and the relocated integration test differs from its telemetry original ONLY by the package clause and 7x newTestStore->newTestPool, with all 7 tests, their fixtures and 5 helpers intact; (3) module boundaries: analytics must not import telemetry for anything charge_gaps-related, telemetry must not reference the moved symbols, cmd/poller remains the only composition root joining derivation to writer; (4) the integration tests still assert what design.md's Test Contract authored up front, not merely what the implementation does; (5) docs-track-structural-change per CLAUDE.md - telemetry/analytics AGENTS.md, README ownership table, docs/battery-consumed-graph.md; (6) Performance-Profile compliance (read-heavy) - this tier adds no query and no index, so confirm none was silently added or dropped; (7) anti-gaming - no task title, criterion or test assertion weakened or deleted to make work look complete. SIGNAL PROVENANCE, read carefully: go build, go vet, gofmt, make build/vet/bins, the three guards, make sqlc, make migrate-status and openspec validate were ASSISTANT-RUN and all pass. The TEST SUITE was ALSO assistant-run (make test, plus a targeted -v run showing all 7 TestGapWriter_ tests PASS not SKIP) under a blanket in-session grant from the owner - it is NOT the owner's own reported pass that this project's Test-Execution-Policy normally requires. KNOWN AND DELIBERATE, do not report as new findings: (a) the metrics/gaps divergence when cmd/poller's step 2 errors is pre-existing and deliberately untouched (I2); (b) internal/charging/AGENTS.md's forbidden-import list never named internal/analytics - real, out of tier-5 scope, logged as backlog item 14, and the doc was reworded to cite charging's closed Allowed-Imports allowlist instead (A5); (c) gofmt -l flags 8 pre-existing files repo-wide, none touched here. findings.note: Stale 'telemetry owns/calls GapWriter' doc claims remain in production code and in analytics' own AGENTS.md, contradicting the actual ownership move and the review brief's completeness check ('no doc claim still says internal/telemetry owns it'). Specific locations: (1) cmd/poller/main.go lines ~9-15 (package-level doc comment: '...hands the flagged days to internal/telemetry's gap writer... See internal/analytics's Reconcile and ConsumedByDay, and telemetry's GapWriter.') and lines ~180-182 (newNightlyReconciler's doc comment: '...hands the flagged days to telemetry's gap writer, which upserts...') -- both were EXPLICITLY required to be reworded by task 1.8 ('Update the doc comment above newNightlyReconciler and the file's own package-level doc comment... reword to internal/analytics's own gap writer'), which is checked off [x] and whose progress.json note ('cmd/poller: NewGapWriter, the gapWriter param type and both ChargeGap literals re-pointed... The two-step reconcile shape... are byte-identical') does not actually claim this part was done -- and it was not. (2) internal/analytics/analytics.go line 30 (GapReconciliationWindow's doc comment): 'reconciles against telemetry's charge_gaps ledger' -- charge_gaps is this module's own table now. (3) internal/analytics/AGENTS.md line 124, the same stale sentence under 'Public interface (the port)' -- directly contradicted by the correct, newly-added 'Data ownership' charge_gaps entry lower in the SAME file, so the module's own doc pack is now internally self-contradictory (one bullet says telemetry owns the ledger, another says analytics does). None of this breaks build/vet/tests or crosses a module boundary, but it is exactly the kind of doc drift CLAUDE.md's 'docs-track-structural-change' rule and this project's AI-efficiency principle (discoverable, non-contradictory docs over facts an agent must re-derive) exist to prevent, and task 1.8 was marked done without fully satisfying its own stated acceptance text. Recommend: reword all three locations to describe analytics as sole owner/caller, mirroring the correctly-updated text elsewhere in the same files (e.g. recalculate.go's already-correct re-point, or gap_writer.go's own doc comment).
